lore: When the hold is too full, the Ebb Warden decides which islands sail out of memory first. Every island has a reload weight: the trouble of bringing it back. The Warden never casts off the home island, and always finds the lightest-burden set of islands to release so the rest can stay resident. Greedy deckhands who drop the biggest island, or the cheapest ones in turn, often pay more.

lines.slack: Slack water. Every island rides resident.
lines.ebb: The tide is going out. Cast these islands off first; the rest stay.
lines.stranded: Even with every island cast off but home, she won't fit. Lighten the home island.
